design_philosophy: The big-screen variant of the mainstream Yoga convertible: a 16" 2K touch canvas on the same Panther Lake platform, aimed at buyers who want maximum screen per dollar and accept the weight penalty. The marketplace dock bundle pushes effective storage to 1.5TB at a steep sale discount.
